description: This Java class implements a file-backed in-memory device registration service for an IoT platform. It manages device registration data, supports persistence to a file, and provides CRUD operations for devices with tenant-level segmentation.
external_methods: updateDevice(String, String, Device, Optional<String>, Span, Handler)

classes.name: FileBasedRegistrationService
classes.description: Implements a file-based in-memory device registry with persistence features, supporting tenant-specific device management and lifecycle operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, loading data from file if configured, and sets up periodic persistence if enabled.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the service, persisting data if needed.

methods.name: loadRegistrationData
methods.description: Loads device registration data from the configured file if available.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds devices from a JSON buffer loaded from the file.

methods.name: checkFileExists
methods.description: Checks for the existence of the registration file, optionally creating it.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Persists current device registration data to the file.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Delegates device registration assertion to the underlying registration service.

methods.name: readDevice
methods.description: Retrieves device data and converts it to JSON format.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Deletes a device entry, handling version checks and modification permissions.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Adds a new device to the registry, generating ID if not provided.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates an existing device, respecting resource versioning and permissions.
